title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
description: CNBC reports Anthropic is the main remaining candidate for a major AI IPO in 2026. Prediction-market odds put a listing at about 75%, and the company is reportedly seeking a valuation near $2 trillion.

title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
description: Replit's CEO says the company has made OpenAI its default model provider over Anthropic. One person familiar with the arrangement said the Anthropic partnership was still in place.

title: AI rapidly improving, could vastly boost U.S. GDP, Anthropic's Clark tells policymakers
description: Anthropic's Jack Clark told policymakers that AI is improving rapidly and could substantially raise U.S. GDP. The remarks add to ongoing policy discussion about AI's economic impact.
